description_en: Retrieves the details of user data storage on the Log Management page
description_zh: 获取日志管理页面里用户数据存储的详情
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem get-data-storage --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1130916744880000 --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDataStorage

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center is located. Specify the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: the asset is in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: the asset is outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

ColdStorageUsedCapacity.description_en: The cold storage capacity used by user logs
ColdStorageUsedCapacity.description_zh: 用户日志使用冷存储的使用量

DataStorageRegionId.description_en: The storage region of user-side logs
DataStorageRegionId.description_zh: 用户侧日志的存储地域

DataStorageRegionPermission.description_en:
Indicates whether the storage region can be modified. By default, the storage region cannot be modified. Contact your product manager to reset the region. The region can be reset only once. Valid values:
allow: The storage region can be modified.
deny: The storage region cannot be modified
DataStorageRegionPermission.description_zh:
是否可以修改存储地域。默认不可以，联系产品经理可以进行地域重置并且只能重置一次。取值：
allow：可以修改。
deny：不可以修改

DataStorageTotalCapacity.description_en: The storage capacity purchased in the upfront billing scenario
DataStorageTotalCapacity.description_zh: 预付费场景下购买的存储用量

DataStorageUsedCapacity.description_en: The storage capacity used in user log management
DataStorageUsedCapacity.description_zh: 用户日志管理中使用的存储量

DataStorageUsedCapacityDetail.description_en: The storage usage details for log management users
DataStorageUsedCapacityDetail.description_zh: 日志管理用户使用的存储详情

LogProject.description_en: The name of the Simple Log Service (SLS) project that stores user logs
LogProject.description_zh: 用户日志对应存储的 SLS Project 名称

NormalizationLogStores.description_en: The details of Logstores for normalized data
NormalizationLogStores.description_zh: 标准化数据的日志库详情

items.description_en: The details of Logstores for normalized data
items.description_zh: 标准化数据的日志库详情

LogStoreName.description_en: The name of the Logstore that stores normalized data
LogStoreName.description_zh: 存储标准化数据的日志库名字

LogStoreTtl.description_en: The storage duration of normalized data
LogStoreTtl.description_zh: 存储标准化数据的存储时长

ActivityName.description_en: The log type of the normalized log
ActivityName.description_zh: 标准化日志的日志类型

CategoryName.description_en: The category of the normalized log

DetectionRuleReferenceCount.description_en: The number of times the normalized dataset is referenced in the threat analysis access center
DetectionRuleReferenceCount.description_zh: 该标准化数据集在威胁分析接入中心被引用的次数

DetectionRuleReferenceProductIds.description_en: The product IDs in the threat analysis access center
DetectionRuleReferenceProductIds.description_zh: 威胁分析接入中心的产品ID

items.description_en: The product IDs in the threat analysis access center
items.description_zh: 威胁分析接入中心的产品ID

LogStoreName.description_en: The Logstore where threat analysis stores normalized logs
LogStoreName.description_zh: 威胁分析存储标准化日志的日志库

LogViewExisted.description_en:
Indicates whether the normalized dataset exists. Valid values:
true: The dataset exists.
false: The dataset does not exist
LogViewExisted.description_zh:
标准化数据集是否存在。取值：
true：存在。
false：不存在

LogViewName.description_en: The name of the normalized dataset

SasLogStores.description_en: The details of raw log storage for Security Center
SasLogStores.description_zh: 云安全中心原始日志存储详情

items.description_en: The details of raw log storage for Security Center
items.description_zh: 云安全中心原始日志存储详情

LogDeliveryGroup.description_en:
The group to which the log belongs. Valid values:
host: host logs.
security: security logs
LogDeliveryGroup.description_zh:
日志所在的分组。取值：
host：主机日志。
security：安全日志

LogDeliveryPermission.description_en:
Indicates whether log delivery is allowed. Log delivery is not available if the service is not purchased. Valid values:
allow: Allowed.
deny: Not allowed
LogDeliveryPermission.description_zh:
是否允许操作日志投递开关，未购买的情况下无法进行投递。取值：
allow：允许。
deny：不允许

LogDeliveryStatus.description_en:
The log delivery status. Valid values:
enable: Log delivery is enabled.
disable: Log delivery is disabled
LogDeliveryStatus.description_zh:
日志投递情况。取值：
enable：开通该日志的投递。
disable：取消该日志的投递

LogDeliveryUpdateTime.description_en: The time of the most recent log delivery operation
LogDeliveryUpdateTime.description_zh: 最近一次操作日志投递的时间

LogStoreExisted.description_en:
Indicates whether the Logstore where the log resides exists. Valid values:
true: The Logstore exists.
false: The Logstore does not exist
LogStoreExisted.description_zh:
日志所在的日志库是否创存在。取值：
true：存在。
false：不存在

LogStoreName.description_en: The name of the Logstore where the log resides
LogStoreName.description_zh: 日志所在日志库的名字

LogStoreTtl.description_en: The storage duration of the Logstore where the log resides. Logs are stored for at least 30 days
LogStoreTtl.description_zh: 该日志所在日志库的存储时长，至少存储30天
